Analysis complete. The decision is clear:

**Diagnostic:** P0217 + coolant at 118°C + coolant smell + white smoke + bearing noise at front of engine = **water pump failure** (bearing shot, seal leaking). Confidence high.

**Repair vs Replace:** The pump is at 487,000 km vs 250,000 km typical life — nearly double its service life. It's safety-critical (cooling). Repair (900 MAD, 4h) on a worn-out bearing/seal is false economy; replace with new pump (labor 3h). → **REPLACE**.

**Takeover vs Replacement:** 
- Replacement via DEP-CASA (only depot with a spare truck, T-11): ETA 137 min > 90 min SLA → penalty **1,175 MAD**.
- No replacement at all → flat penalty **8,000 MAD**.
- **T-03 takeover**: 14 free pallets for 10 needed, heading to Marrakech, only 36.7 km away → far cheaper than a late replacement. → **TAKEOVER**.

**Supplier:** SUP-ATLAS (score 73.3, best overall; 6.4h delivery, 12-month warranty, 92% on-time). SUP-SAHARA is marginally cheaper/faster but lower on-time (88%) and rating. For an urgent truck repair, Atlas balances speed and reliability best.

**Depot:** DEP-SETTAT is closest (83 km) but has no workshop. DEP-MARRAKECH (114 km, workshop) is the nearest workshop — driver brings the broken truck there for repair.
